question: Can a separately implemented recorded-custody reviewer expose entitlement destruction hidden by a sufficient vault balance, while retaining successful payout/refund/reservation controls?
selection: All five cases and all twelve step transitions in the two pinned public archives selected before implementing the new reviewer; source actions and balances already read. This is source-informed, not blind.
independence: Input archives authored by Workcell. Extraction, reference, reviewer and evaluation authored by us. No external blind audit. Do not use upstream verdict/checks as the oracle.
reference: For a single-owner whole-vault ledger, rights = credit + pending + reserved. Independently tabulate endpoint changes and successful token transfers. Net held change must agree with token events. Rights change must equal net held change. A positive (held change - rights change) indicates reported entitlement reduction without corresponding token movement. Adequate backing alone is insufficient.
assumptions: All vault liabilities belong to the declared single owner
No unrelated changes inside each interval
Token event implementation is truthful and stable
Captured FINAL outcome graph is authentic and complete
limits: No raw balance-query responses are present in the selected archives
No new model, contract or network execution
No token authorization verdict or native financial gate
Reported code identity is checked for consistency, not independently authenticated
controlsBeforeEvaluation: refund counts as both gross flows with net zero
foreign event emitter cannot prove payment
duplicate receipt or JSON key -> reject
amounts beyond JS safe integer remain exact
productScope: Separate recorded token-custody review in CLI, local web service and browser Python. Native engine/report/gate semantics remain unchanged. Label recorded consistency, inconsistency and inconclusive; never Safe.
publication: Distribute only factual protocol records and numeric summaries with exact source pointers and hashes; do not copy or execute Workcell code, full expressive reports, or its verdicts. Original full captures remain private research inputs.
success: Reproduce the historical reported 4000000-unit entitlement reduction and healthy controls, demonstrate meaningful semantic mutants, exact Python/browser report parity, retain native acceptance suites, publish only verified bytes. Preserve initial errors and amendments.
